Advisory Framework

Risk Management & Insurance Advisory Framework

Insurance is only as effective as the risk assessment preceding it. We help clients identify, prioritize, and structure protection against Nigerian operational hazards.

1. Exposure Identification

Systematic survey of operational assets, supply bottlenecks, contractual covenants, and regulatory compliance duties.

2. Quantitative & Qualitative Risk Evaluation

Analyzing loss frequency, potential maximum loss (PML), and financial resilience thresholds.

3. Mitigation & Internal Control Advisory

Implementing physical protection, fleet safety guidelines, and security protocols to diminish loss probability.

4. Strategic Insurance Transfer & Placement

Negotiating favorable terms, warranties, and competitive pricing across top-rated NAICOM-authorised underwriters.

5. Active Claims Advocacy & Continuous Auditing

Standing beside our clients through loss adjustment, documentation, and prompt settlement advocacy.
